definitions.between_cv_over_within_cv: between_cv_population / within_cv_median, null with reason for zero denominator
definitions.between_cv_population: population stdev/mean across the 12 child p50 elapsed centers
definitions.nearest_rank: rank=ceil(q*n), one-indexed, for between-child p25/p75/p95; group median remains the protocol linear median
definitions.observed_affinity: categorical actual_affinity from validated launch sidecars; no numeric affinity difference inferred
definitions.paired_dispersion: pinned aggregate dispersion / unpinned aggregate dispersion over paired children for p50 and p95; includes raw IQR/MAD and normalized IQR/median, MAD/median point ratios plus frozen paired bootstrap intervals
definitions.population_cv: per child population stdev(elapsed_ns)/mean(elapsed_ns) over 80 elapsed samples
definitions.within_cv_median: median of the 12 per-child population CV values per condition/cell
